title: RitualCore Altar: First Steps
summary: Build the Basic Altar array and learn diagnostics before lighting a ritual.

blocks.title: Build The Shape
blocks.body: Place a Basic Altar with at least four Rune Circle blocks and an Offering Pedestal before expecting advanced rituals to work.

blocks.title: Read Diagnostics
blocks.body: Use empty-hand interaction to inspect the altar state. Sneak diagnostics should help you debug the array without spending resources.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A clean first ritual is Aether Calibration with valid structure, expected catalyst use, and a clear altar status afterward.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
